passages.title: Fitness Center Hours Change
passages.body:
Starting September 1, the Oakridge Office Park fitness center will open at 6 A.M. instead of 7 A.M. on weekdays to accommodate early-shift employees. Weekend hours (9 A.M.–5 P.M.) remain unchanged.

Towels are now provided free of charge at the front desk.

passages.title: Harbor City Ferry Adds Evening Service
passages.body:
Beginning next month, the Harbor City ferry will run until 11 P.M. on Fridays and Saturdays, two hours later than its current schedule. The change is a response to requests from island residents who work evening shifts in the city's restaurants and theaters.

The additional trips will be funded for one year by a grant from the regional transportation authority. After that, the city will decide whether to continue the service based on the number of passengers.

Fares will not change. A one-way ticket costs $4.50, and monthly passes remain available for $90.

passages.title: Smart Thermostats Gain Popularity Among Small Businesses
passages.body:
A growing number of small businesses are installing smart thermostats to reduce energy costs. These devices learn a building's usage patterns and automatically adjust the temperature when rooms are empty.

According to a survey by the Small Business Energy Council, 38 percent of businesses with fewer than 50 employees now use smart thermostats, up from 21 percent three years ago. Owners reported average savings of 12 percent on heating and cooling bills.

“The initial cost was about $300 per unit, but we recovered that within a year,” said Jorge Alvarado, owner of three bakeries in San Diego. He noted that the devices can also be controlled remotely through a smartphone app, which allows him to adjust settings from home.

However, some owners mentioned drawbacks. Several said that setting up the devices was more complicated than expected, a few found that the devices occasionally lost their Wi-Fi connection, and others expressed concerns about data privacy.

Dear Ms. Ito,

We are writing to inform you of changes to your Silverline Rewards credit card, effective March 1. [[1]]

First, the annual fee will increase from $45 to $60. In return, you will now earn two points for every dollar spent at restaurants and grocery stores, up from one point. [[2]] Points can be redeemed for travel, gift cards, or statement credits.

Second, we are introducing free travel insurance for flights purchased with your card. [[3]] Details of the coverage are included in the enclosed brochure.

If you do not wish to accept these changes, you may close your account at any time before March 1 without penalty. [[4]] We value your membership and thank you for choosing Silverline Bank.

Sincerely,
Customer Accounts Department

passages.title: Bright Sparks Electrical Services — Invoice #7714

However, I believe there is an error. The service was performed on a Tuesday afternoon, not on a weekend, so I don't think the emergency fee applies. Could you please send me a corrected invoice?

Hello,

I'm a freelance graphic designer, and I'd like to work at HiveSpace every weekday. I'd prefer to have my own desk where I can leave my monitor and drawing tablet overnight. I also meet with clients regularly, probably about five hours a month.

passages.title: Maplewood Summer Market — Vendor Applications Now Open
passages.body:
The Maplewood Summer Market will take place every Saturday from June 7 to August 30 in Central Square.

Booth fees: standard booth (3 m × 3 m), $40 per Saturday; corner booth (3 m × 3 m, two open sides), $55 per Saturday. Vendors who apply for the full season (all 13 Saturdays) receive a 15 percent discount.

Food vendors must provide a valid health permit. Applications are due by May 1.

Hello,

I would like to apply for a corner booth for the entire season. We sell homemade tamales and fresh juices. I have attached our health permit, which was renewed in March.

Last year we had a standard booth near the fountain, and many customers told us they had trouble finding us.

Thank you,
Elena Ruiz

Dear Ms. Ruiz,

Thank you for your application. Unfortunately, all corner booths for the full season have already been assigned. However, a corner booth is available for the Saturdays in August, and I can offer you a standard booth for the earlier dates. Your booth will be located at the main entrance to the square, which is the busiest spot in the market.

Please let me know by April 30 whether this arrangement suits you.

Best regards,
Ben Atwood

passages.title: Kestrel Logistics Newsletter — Community Day
passages.body:
On Friday, May 16, Kestrel employees will spend the day volunteering instead of working. This year, staff can choose one of three projects:

- Riverside Park cleanup (morning only, 8 A.M.–12 P.M.)
- Food bank sorting (all day, 9 A.M.–4 P.M.)
- Reading program at Elm Street Elementary School (afternoon only, 1 P.M.–3 P.M.)

Employees should sign up on the intranet by May 2. Lunch will be provided for all volunteers at the food bank.

passages.title: Community Day Sign-Up
passages.body: Thank you for signing up! You will receive a confirmation by e-mail.

Hello,

I signed up for the food bank project, but I've just been told that I need to attend an important client meeting on the morning of May 16. Would it be possible to switch to a project that takes place in the afternoon? I'd be happy to help wherever there is the most need.

Thank you,
Grace

questions.prompt: What change will take place on September 1?
options: The center will open earlier on weekdays.
A membership fee will be introduced.
The center will close for repairs.
questions.explanation: Ouverture à 6 h au lieu de 7 h en semaine.
questions.trap: Les horaires du week-end restent inchangés.

questions.prompt: What is now provided at no cost?
questions.explanation: « Towels are now provided free of charge ».
questions.trap: « free of charge » est paraphrasé par « at no cost ».

questions.prompt: At 2:44 P.M., what does Ms. Mendes most likely mean when she writes, “You're a lifesaver”?
options: She wants Mr. Park to give the presentation.
Mr. Park's advice solved her problem.
She will be late for her presentation.
questions.explanation: L'interrupteur caché était la cause de la panne ; « You're a lifesaver » remercie chaleureusement M. Park de l'avoir tirée d'affaire.
questions.trap: Prendre l'expression au sens littéral (sauver une vie).

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the power switch?
options: It is not easy to see.
questions.explanation: « It's behind the curtain » et « It happens to everyone » : l'interrupteur est peu visible.
questions.trap: L'interrupteur n'est pas en panne : il fallait seulement l'allumer.

options: By paying with a credit card

options: It can be used for sandwiches.
It is valid at all cafés in the city.
It expires at the end of the year.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To invite staff to an event
questions.explanation: « Please join us for a farewell reception » : invitation à un pot de départ.
questions.trap: Il s'agit d'un départ à la retraite, pas d'une promotion.

questions.prompt: What are readers asked to do by Wednesday?
questions.explanation: « please give your donation to Ahmed in accounting by Wednesday ».
questions.trap: Ahmed travaille à la comptabilité, mais on ne lui remet pas de rapport.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A new restaurant on the island
questions.explanation: Le ferry circulera deux heures plus tard les vendredis et samedis.

questions.prompt: Why was the change made?
questions.explanation: « a response to requests from island residents who work evening shifts ».

questions.prompt: What will determine whether the evening service continues after one year?
questions.explanation: « the city will decide … based on the number of passengers ».
questions.trap: La subvention ne couvre qu'un an, mais c'est la fréquentation qui décidera de la suite.

questions.prompt: What did Ms. Moreno rate the lowest?
questions.explanation: Le restaurant a la note la plus basse (3/5).
questions.trap: La valeur pour le prix a 4, pas 3.

questions.prompt: What did Tomás do for Ms. Moreno?
questions.explanation: « who arranged a last-minute boat tour for my family » : une excursion.

options: She does not want to be contacted.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a new laboratory director
To inform staff about safety improvements
questions.explanation: Postes de rinçage oculaire, nouvelles lunettes, formation : la note présente des mesures de sécurité.
questions.trap: Aucun accident n'est mentionné.

questions.prompt: What are staff members asked to do?
questions.explanation: « Please pick yours up from the supply room by Friday » : récupérer leurs lunettes.
questions.trap: L'installation aura lieu le soir, mais ce n'est pas le personnel qui s'en charge.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? “These are lighter and less likely to fog up than the current model.”
questions.explanation: « These » renvoie aux nouvelles lunettes de sécurité présentées juste avant [2] ; « fog up » (s'embuer) concerne des lunettes.
questions.trap: Placer la phrase après les postes de rinçage [1], qui ne peuvent pas s'embuer.

options: At a store that sells goods in large quantities
questions.explanation: « I'm at the wholesale store right now » : un magasin de vente en gros.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The growing use of a technology by small businesses
The opening of a bakery chain

questions.prompt: By how many percentage points has the use of smart thermostats among small businesses increased?
questions.trap: 12 % correspond aux économies moyennes, pas à la hausse.

questions.prompt: In paragraph 3, the word “recovered” is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: « we recovered that within a year » : l'investissement de 300 $ a été rentabilisé, regagné grâce aux économies.

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned as a drawback of smart thermostats?

questions.explanation: La phrase précise l'assurance voyage présentée juste avant [3], et précède le renvoi à la brochure détaillée.

questions.trap: 75 $ correspond aux 5 heures facturées, sans déduire les 2 heures incluses.

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Grant's profession?

questions.explanation: « Food vendors must provide a valid health permit. »
